name: Case Management Platform
description: A pattern for systems that manage the lifecycle of cases, applications, or requests through defined workflows. Common in government for processing citizen applications, managing investigations, handling complaints, or tracking service requests through multi-stage approval processes.
whenToUse: Processing citizen applications that move through defined stages (submitted, reviewed, approved/rejected)
Managing investigations or complaints with evidence gathering and decision workflows
Tracking service requests through multi-team handoffs and SLA-driven timelines
Workloads requiring configurable business rules that change with policy updates
Systems needing comprehensive audit trails for every case action and decision
whenNotToUse: Simple CRUD applications without workflow or lifecycle management
Real-time transactional services where immediate response is required
Bulk data processing without individual case tracking
Services where a commercial case management product (ServiceNow, Dynamics) would suffice
Reporting-only systems that consume case data but don't manage case lifecycle

typicalComponents.name: Case API Service
typicalComponents.purpose: Manage case lifecycle, state transitions, and business rule enforcement
typicalComponents.technology: Node.js, .NET, or Java with workflow engine

typicalComponents.name: Workflow Engine
typicalComponents.purpose: Define and execute case processing workflows with configurable rules
typicalComponents.technology: Camunda, AWS Step Functions, or custom state machine

typicalComponents.name: Case Database
typicalComponents.purpose: Store case records, history, and current state with full audit trail
typicalComponents.technology: PostgreSQL with temporal tables or event sourcing

typicalComponents.name: Document Management
typicalComponents.purpose: Store and retrieve documents, evidence, and attachments associated with cases
typicalComponents.technology: S3 with metadata, Azure Blob, or SharePoint

typicalComponents.name: Notification Service
typicalComponents.purpose: Send status updates to citizens and internal users at workflow milestones

typicalComponents.name: Search and Reporting
typicalComponents.purpose: Enable case search, filtering, and management reporting across the caseload
typicalComponents.technology: Elasticsearch, Azure Cognitive Search, or PostgreSQL full-text

securityControls: Implement role-based access control with case-level permissions (own cases vs all cases)
Encrypt case data at rest and in transit, especially for sensitive citizen information
Implement comprehensive audit logging for every case action, view, and state change
Apply data retention policies aligned with statutory requirements per case type
Implement document scanning for malware on all uploaded attachments
Enforce separation of duties for case decisions (reviewer cannot be the same as approver)
resilienceConsiderations: Case data must not be lost — implement durable storage with point-in-time recovery
Workflow state must be recoverable after system failures without losing progress
Design for idempotent state transitions to handle retry scenarios safely
Implement optimistic locking to prevent concurrent case updates causing data corruption
Queue-based processing for bulk operations to prevent timeout failures
costConsiderations: Database costs scale with case volume and retention period
Document storage costs grow over time — implement lifecycle policies for archived cases
Commercial workflow engine licensing may apply (Camunda, Pega)
Search infrastructure costs for large case volumes
Consider the cost of building custom vs procuring commercial case management
Factor in ongoing business rule maintenance and configuration costs
operationalConsiderations: Business rules and workflows change with policy — design for configurability
SLA monitoring needed to track cases approaching deadline
Reporting on case volumes, processing times, and bottlenecks for management
Data migration planning for cases from legacy systems
User training for caseworkers on new workflows and system features
Regular review of workflow efficiency and identification of process improvements

services.name: Amazon RDS (PostgreSQL)
services.purpose: Case data storage with audit trail

services.name: Azure App Service or Container Apps

questionsToAsk: What are the defined case lifecycle stages and transition rules?
How frequently do business rules and workflows change with policy updates?
What SLAs apply to case processing times and how are breaches escalated?
What volume of cases is expected and what is the growth trajectory?
Are there existing cases in legacy systems that need migrating?
What reporting and management information is required from the case data?
commonMistakes: Hard-coding business rules that change with policy, making updates require code deployments
Not implementing proper audit trails, failing compliance requirements
Building custom case management when a commercial product would be more appropriate
Not planning for data migration from legacy case management systems
Underestimating the complexity of workflow rules and edge cases in case processing
